question: Who among the following won the first National Film Award for Best Choreography in 1992?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Laxmibai Kolhapurkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **first National Film Award **for **Best Choreography **in **1992 **went to **Laxmibai Kolhapurkar **for **choreographing **a song from **Marathi Film “Ek Hota Vidushak”.** 
 
• She became the **first woman choreographer **to win this **National Award in India**.
 
• **Laxmibai Kolhapurkar **is **known **for **Gandh Matila Aala(1995) **,**Ek Hota Vidushak(1992).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Saroj Khan **was an **Indian dance choreographer **in **Hindi cinema**. She was **born **in **Bombay State**, **India**. She was **best known **for the **dance form mujra **and was the **first woman choreographer **in **Bollywood**. She **choreographed **more than **3000 songs.**
 
• **Vaibhavi Merchant **is an **Indian dance choreographer **working in **Bollywood films**. She **won National Film Award **for **Best Choreography **for the **song Dholi Taaro Dhol Baaje **from **Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam in 1999**.
 
• **Shiamak Davar **is an **Indian choreographer**, noted as one of the **first to bring contemporary jazz **and **western forms **of **dance to India**. He **is known as the guru of contemporary dance in India.**
